messages:
Jordan (People Ops): Quick heads-up — we're seeing a handful of last-minute reviewer conflicts for the current review window (double-booked, OOO, timezone mismatches). Can managers please confirm backup reviewers for any change requests by EOD?
Priya (ENG Manager): Noted. I have two reviewers who can cover but both are CET and one is on PTO next week. Can we swap their review slots to earlier in the week?
Jordan (People Ops): Yes — swapping slots is fine. If a reviewer is PTO, please list an explicit backup and add them to the review in Lattice. Also add an "alternate reviewer" in the form comment so we have an audit trail.
Marcus (Platform): Do we have a checklist for reviewers to follow? Last cycle I got inconsistent criteria across reviewers.
Jordan (People Ops): Good call. Use this short reviewer checklist: ```- Read self-assessment + manager notes - Check rubric items: impact, ownership, craft - Note 2 examples (strength + improvement) - Use calibration tags: "underscored"/"overstated" if needed - Add final rating rationale (1-2 sentences)```
Ellie (Recruiting): Heads-up — some candidates' interviews overlap with reviewers' scheduled calibration slots. If managers move reviewers, ping me with the new times and I'll re-route interviews.
Ryota (EM): For timezone swaps — can we publish two calibration drop-in times (one for US/APAC and one for EU)? Makes it easier for last-minute matching.
Jordan (People Ops): Sure — proposing 30m drop-ins: 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET tomorrow and 08:00 PT / 01:00 JST Thursday. These are optional canaries for calibration questions and reviewer swaps.
Priya (ENG Manager): I'll join the 17:00 CET session. Can you share the short form where we add backups?
Jordan (People Ops): Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-review-forms (dropbox folder with: reviewer_backup_template.md, reviewer_checklist.md, reviewer_swap_log.csv). Please populate `reviewer_backup_template.md` with name + email + Lattice handle.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Calibration drop-in (09:00 PT / 17:00 CET)" in 14 hours. :bell:
Marcus (Platform): Quick Q — if a reviewer swaps mid-cycle, do we re-open the review for edits?
Jordan (People Ops): Yes — manager or assigned backup should add an "edit note" in the review and then finalize. Don't create duplicate review entries. If unsure, escalate to me or drop into the calibration session.
Ryota (EM): Will the calibration panel include examples of borderline cases? I'd like to see 2 anonymized writeups.
Jordan (People Ops): We'll drop 2 redacted examples in the folder before the drop-in.
Ellie (Recruiting): Thanks — I'll block any interviews that conflict with backup reviewers who end up taking slots.
Priya (ENG Manager): All right, marking my team with backups and updating the template now. :white_check_mark:
Jordan (People Ops): Awesome — if anyone has emergencies after EOD, DM me and cc people-ops@redwood.com. We'll triage. Thanks all! :pray:
